'''Mr. Monday Night DROIDS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mr. Monday Night]]
* '''Published:''' 15 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion Night DS 2001 DROIDS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

yeah...droids are definately powerful in the Theed expansion!!! Sweet

The published list has 61 cards.
